name: audioshake-cli
description: Run AudioShake models from Codex with the audioshake CLI and Python library: stem separation, dialogue isolation, speech clean-up, lyric transcription and alignment.

interface.shortDescription: Stems, dialogue isolation, transcription and lyric alignment
interface.longDescription: AudioShake is a platform for state-of-the-art AI source separation, transcription, and content analysis — powering post-production workflows, karaoke, dubbing, speech enhancement, music copyright compliance, improving ASR accuracy, and AI training data preparation — at scale, and in production. This plugin teaches Codex to run AudioShake models on audio and video files with the audioshake CLI and Python library: stem separation (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and more), dialogue and effects isolation, speech denoise and dereverb, multi-speaker separation, music detection and removal, and lyric transcription and alignment.
defaultPrompt: Split song.wav into vocals, drums, bass and other
Pull the dialogue out of scene.mp4 and drop the music
Transcribe the lyrics of track.mp3 with word timings
